title: Engraved Key (Salazon)

sources.title: Zhentarim Basement
markers: hatch in the far corner of the barn

summary: Salazon’s key opens the barn hatch leading to the Zhentarim cellar.

fields.Acquisition: Salazon carries it and can hand it over after you persuade him or give the password.
fields.Use: Use the hatch in the far corner of the barn at Waukeen’s Rest.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay, acquisition, and pinned source evidence.
